name: Raíz Market
title: Good food. Closer to home.
summary: A local shopping concept connecting neighborhood producers with people looking for seasonal food and predictable pickup.
audience: People shopping locally who need clear pickup times and product availability.
problem: Small producers often share stock through scattered posts and messages, making availability and pickup arrangements difficult to compare.
question: How might we help neighbors discover seasonal products and plan one reliable pickup?
value: Discover the season in your neighborhood.
description: A shared marketplace organizes seasonal produce, producer stories, and collection windows into a single shopping flow.
insight: Pickup details belong beside product availability, rather than appearing only at checkout.

process.title: Discovery
process.description: Define assumptions and a research plan for people shopping locally who need clear pickup times and product availability.

process.title: Define
process.description: Pickup details belong beside product availability, rather than appearing only at checkout.

process.title: Design
process.description: Map the main journey, compare wireframe alternatives, and develop a coherent visual language.

process.title: Review
process.description: Prepare a usability study to evaluate comprehension, recovery, and task completion. No study results are claimed.

architecture.description: Four connected destinations organize the primary journey. Each step retains context so people can review their choices before continuing.

wireframes.description: Early layouts test product-led discovery against producer-led discovery. Pickup availability stays visible in both alternatives.

screens.description: Illustrative interface compositions for this fictional concept; not screenshots of a released product.

designSystem.description: A compact foundation of clear type, consistent spacing, and reusable controls supports the main journey.
designSystem.typography: Inter for interface text · Playfair Display for editorial headings

closing.title: Designed to make the next step clearer.
closing.description: The next study would explore how substitutions, stock changes, and accessibility at collection points should be communicated.
closing.credits: Fictional portfolio case study. All narratives, timelines, and interface examples are demo content; no client work or validated research outcomes are implied.
